id_placeholder: Custom ID (optional, leave empty for random)
files_placeholder: Enter file or folder paths, one per line
creator: Creator
share_gone: This share has expired or been cancelled
no_permission_tip: To create a share, you need "Share" permission.
burn_after_read_help: The share closes after the first visitor starts reading it, the same as a maximum access count of 1. Previewing counts as reading.
allow_preview_help: Players, the image viewer, document viewers and thumbnails may open the files.
allow_download_help: The download button and direct links are offered to visitors.
policy_note: These switches are a policy for this page and for well-behaved clients, not copy protection. Anyone who can view a file can also save its bytes.
max_accessed_help: 0 means unlimited, or 1 when burn after read is on. Each visitor (by IP) counts once per 30 minutes.
expired_or_used_up: This share has expired or been used up.
preview_disabled: The owner of this share disabled preview.
download_disabled: The owner of this share disabled download.
